entities.name: Bifunctional Nnr
observations: The 492-residue query sequence contains YjeF_N (PF03853) at positions 34–182 and Carb_kinase (PF01256) at positions 243–466.
Homologs Q2RGI2, A1S0R2, and B5YIM0 are reviewed bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzymes with 32.2–34.3% identity and approximately 86.6% query coverage.

The protein is inferred to catalyze NAD(P)HX epimerization and ADP-dependent dehydration of (S)-NAD(P)HX; exact activity remains homology-supported rather than directly experimentally demonstrated for this sequence.
The homolog annotations specify potassium binding, with one K+ per subunit.
Sequence-derived properties: 492 aa, estimated molecular mass 51.85 kDa, theoretical pI 8.22.

entities.name: NAD(P)HX epimerization
observations: The enzyme interconverts (6R)-NADHX and (6S)-NADHX and analogously interconverts (6R)-NADPHX and (6S)-NADPHX.
Corresponding EC annotation in homologs: 5.1.99.6; Rhea mappings include RHEA:32215 and RHEA:32227.

entities.name: ADP-dependent NAD(P)HX dehydration
observations: The enzyme converts (6S)-NADHX plus ADP to NADH plus AMP, phosphate, and H+; the NADPH analogue is converted to NADPH plus AMP, phosphate, and H+.
Corresponding EC annotation in homologs: 4.2.1.136; Rhea mappings include RHEA:32223 and RHEA:32235.

entities.name: Potassium cofactor
observations: Reviewed Nnr homologs are annotated to bind one potassium ion per subunit.

entities.name: NAD(P)H metabolite repair
observations: The enzyme repairs hydrated NADH/NADPH, damaged cofactors formed by enzymatic or heat-dependent hydration, and is annotated to metabolite repair and nicotinamide nucleotide metabolism.
